capital_allocation_and_shareholder_retur.value: For FY2025-FY2027, NAVER states shareholder returns will be cash dividends or share repurchases/cancellations at approximately 25%-35% of the two-year average consolidated FCF, subject to business conditions and debt repayment plans.

wallapop_acquisition.purpose: Acquire a strategic European C2C marketplace and user base to serve as a base for European business expansion

nvidia_third_party_capital_increase.condition_precedent: NAVER must secure at least USD 9 billion of computing infrastructure for expansion of the AI Factory business, excluding funds raised through this capital increase.
nvidia_third_party_capital_increase.lockup: New shares are subject to mandatory electronic registration with Korea Securities Depository and a one-year restriction on withdrawal and sale.
nvidia_third_party_capital_increase.final_share_count_note: The disclosed share count and KRW proceeds are provisional. Final share count is determined using the KRW/USD market-average exchange rate at the contractual Measurement Date and the fixed issue price of KRW 204,500, with fractional shares discarded.

important_changes.value: FY2025 operating expenses were reported as KRW 9.8 trillion, up 12.2% year over year; operating income was KRW 2.2 trillion, up 11.6%, with operating margin 18.3%.
H1 2026 revenue was KRW 6.629816 trillion and operating income KRW 1.062067 trillion, versus H1 2025 revenue KRW 5.701868 trillion and operating income KRW 1.026855 trillion.
important_changes.original_location: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income, PDF p.49
important_changes.note: No growth percentages are derived here.

important_changes.value: NAVER completed acquisition of Wallapop on 2026-01-30 and added Wallapop, S.L. to the consolidation scope.
important_changes.original_location: Company history / major contracts / consolidation scope

important_changes.value: NAVER issued two USD 500 million senior unsecured green-note tranches on 2026-04-21, maturing in 2031 and 2033, and states the proceeds are being used to refinance existing ESG bonds and fund eligible green projects.
NAVER cancelled 4,901,094 treasury shares on 2026-08-03 after a 2026-07-24 board resolution; the half-year report states remaining treasury shares became 2,238,815 after the cancellation.
important_changes.original_location: Treasury share and post-period event disclosures

risk_and_commitment_disclosures.value: The third-party capital increase with NVIDIA is conditional on NAVER securing at least USD 9 billion of computing infrastructure for AI Factory expansion; payment/listing dates are contractual maximum dates and may be extended.

The final share count and KRW proceeds of the NVIDIA capital increase depend on the KRW/USD market-average exchange rate at the Measurement Date; the disclosed 7,241,564 shares and KRW 1.480899838 trillion are provisional.
NAVER reports that public bonds are subject to investor-protection covenants including restrictions on collateral creation and asset disposals, and states it was in compliance as of 2026-06-30.
